name: create_event
description: Schedule a calendar event. Use when booking meetings or appointments with a specific title, start date/time, and optional participants.

title.description: Summary or title of the meeting or calendar event

start_time.description: Start time of the event in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS) or date (YYYY-MM-DD)

end_time.description: End time of the event in ISO 8601 format or date

location.description: Physical room or virtual link for the event
